jobs.title: Quality Control Technician
jobs.description:
Job Title: Quality Control Technician

Shift:
Monday-Friday 2PM-10:30PM PT

Job Description

The Quality Control Technician performs a wide range of chemical, physical, and instrumental tests on raw materials, in-process products, finished goods, and customer samples to ensure consistent product quality and adherence to specifications. This role follows established analytical procedures, validates methods, manages laboratory data in electronic systems, and collaborates closely with Quality, Production, and R&D teams to support reliable manufacturing processes and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Perform chemical, physical, and instrumental testing on raw materials, in-process, finished, and customer product samples, including volumetric and gravimetric analyses, pH measurement, FTIR, SPG, RI, and other instrumental techniques.
Conduct functional testing such as IACS and thermal conductivity as needed to verify product performance.
Follow written analytical procedures and standard operating procedures to ensure consistency and compliance in all testing activities.
Validate established analytical methods and assist in troubleshooting testing procedures to maintain accurate and reliable results.
Collect, enter, review, and validate laboratory data in WinLIMS or similar data management systems, perform necessary calculations, and prepare results for review and approval.
Communicate sample status, test progress, and final results clearly and promptly to Quality, Production, and R&D teams.
Maintain accurate and complete laboratory documentation, including SOPs, test methods, protocols, deviations, batch records, and certificates of analysis (COAs).
Handle hazardous materials safely, ensuring proper storage, labeling, and disposal in accordance with site safety and chemical hygiene protocols.
Follow all site safety guidelines and chemical hygiene practices to maintain a safe working environment.
Troubleshoot basic process and testing issues, identify potential root causes, and escalate complex problems appropriately.
Log process and test data accurately using computer systems and software tools.
Work collaboratively in a team environment, supporting colleagues and contributing to a culture of quality and continuous improvement.
Manage time effectively to prioritize multiple testing assignments and meet production and customer deadlines.
Maintain strong attention to detail and focus on process control, documentation accuracy, and overall product quality.

Essential Skills

Experience in quality control and analytical testing within a laboratory or production environment.
Ability to perform chemical and physical analyses, including volumetric and gravimetric methods and pH measurement.
Hands-on experience with instrumental techniques such as FTIR, SPG, RI, and related analytical equipment.
Capability to conduct functional testing, including IACS and thermal conductivity measurements.
Proficiency in following written analytical procedures and standard operating procedures accurately.
Experience collecting, entering, reviewing, and validating data in WinLIMS or similar laboratory information management systems.
Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and the ability to log and manage process data.
Strong attention to detail with a focus on process control, thorough documentation, and maintaining high quality standards.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment, follow instructions, and communicate clearly with cross-functional groups.
Good time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
Comfort working with hazardous materials while adhering to safety and chemical hygiene protocols.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

B.S. in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related scientific or engineering field.
materials testing, including experience working with metals or similar materials.
Quality control experience in an industrial, manufacturing, or laboratory setting.
Laboratory experience gained in academia or industry, including hands-on work with analytical instruments and test methods.
Familiarity with statistical analysis software such as Minitab is a plus.
Strong documentation skills for maintaining SOPs, test methods, protocols, deviations, batch records, and COAs.
Effective interpersonal and communication skills for collaborating with Quality, Production, and R&D teams.
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot basic process and testing issues and escalate more complex problems appropriately.

Work Environment

The role is based in a laboratory environment that supports production and quality control operations. The Quality Control Technician works with a variety of analytical instruments and functional testing equipment, including FTIR and tools for SPG, RI, IACS, and thermal conductivity measurements. Daily work involves handling chemicals and hazardous materials in accordance with established safety and chemical hygiene protocols, with an emphasis on proper storage, labeling, and disposal. The position relies on computer-based tools such as WinLIMS or similar laboratory information management systems, as well as Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, for data entry, analysis, and reporting. The technician collaborates regularly with Quality, Production, and R&D teams, contributing to a supportive, team-oriented culture focused on accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Job Type & Location

This is a Contract to Hire position based out of Fremont, CA.

Pay And Benefits

Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors.

Summary

Laboratory Assistant utilizes universal precautions and appropriate laboratory safety practices and knowledge of laboratory science to perform a variety of technical and clerical duties and tasks. The Assistant performs duties such as venipuncture, EKG’s, specimen processing and urine drug screen collections.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The following list of job duties fall within the scope of the laboratory assistant. Staff only perform the job duties for which they have completed initial and annual competency assessments. All lab assistants do not perform all functions listed.

Verifies the accuracy of patient registration information in computer.
Prioritizes and enters orders.
Obtains specimens for testing for all age groups including finger stick glucose.
Receives and processes all requests for laboratory orders, results and reports. Enters and retrieves data from computer system.
Answers telephones and routes calls as appropriate.
Processes and packages specimens as required for delivery to main laboratory and/or reference laboratories.
Review pending logs and reports every shift.
Performs physician prescribed EKG testing.
Performs legal drug collection.
Inventories and maintains department supplies. Notifies Supervisor of supply needs when stock is low.
Cleans glassware from all areas of the laboratory.
May perform Evidential Breath Testing (EBT).
May perform registrations using procedure specified in training.
May set up microbiology cultures.
May need to transport specimens to other locations.
May perform document scanning into the electronic medical record.
Demonstrates System Values in performance and behavior.
Complies with System policies and procedures.
Other duties as may be assigned.

Education And Experience

High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one to three months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Licenses, Certifications

Minimum CPT1 (California: Phlebotomy Technician) or higher. Tahoe Forest Hospital Laboratory Assistants are also needed to cover events at the Incline Village Community Hospital. In these cases, the staff that are scheduled at that location are licensed by the State of Nevada and meet all requirements of the IVCH Lab Assistant Job Description.

Other Experience/Qualifications

Meets venipuncture requirements of the California Business and Professional Code and The California Administrative Code. Previous phlebotomy experience required. Experience in the State of California is preferred. Knowledge of medical terminology is preferred.

jobs.title: Care Coordinator - Russian/Farsi/Dari Bilingual Speakers Preferred
jobs.description:
Description

Join Elica’s mission and become a part of a team where every day is an opportunity to make a positive impact in your community!

At Elica Health Centers, we share a common goal: provide the best possible patient care to our growing community! Our passion extends throughout Elica, from the exceptional healthcare services we provide to our underserved patients at our Community Health Clinics and state-of-the-art mobile medicine program, Health on Wheels, to our Resource Center where we empower patients and members of the community to connect with resources to help them build healthy and full lives.

We are growing our Enhanced Care Management (ECM) program at Elica! ECM is a key part of CalAIM’s new statewide Medi-Cal benefit available to select “Populations of Focus" with complex needs and who are facing difficult life and health circumstances. This program is focused on breaking down the traditional walls of health care – extending beyond hospitals and health care settings into communities. ECM will address clinical and non-clinical needs of the highest-need enrollees through intensive coordination of health and health-related services and will meet beneficiaries wherever they are – on the street, in a shelter, in their doctor's office, or at home.

What You'll Do

Care Coordinators assist patients to receive timely and effective care from Elica’s internal providers as well as referrals to community resources outside of Elica. The ultimate goal is well-coordinated care and optimal clinical outcomes. Care Coordinators work with patients individually and within a team environment to achieve these goals and because of their

education & skills, are best able to educate patients as to the health benefits of coordinated care.

Benefits

Retirement Savings Made Easy: Enjoy a 403(b) retirement plan with up to 4% employer matching and 100% immediate vesting—start building your future from day one!
Comprehensive Healthcare Options: Choose from two Anthem Blue Cross PPO plans for medical, plus dental and vision coverage for you and your family.
Employer-Funded HRA: Our Health Reimbursement Arrangement helps cover out-of-pocket medical costs, giving you peace of mind.
Flexible Spending Accounts: Take advantage of two FSA options: Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA, tailored to suit your needs.
Security for the Unexpected: We provide company-paid basic Life and AD&D Insurance, with options to enhance coverage.
Enhanced Protection: Explore additional benefits like Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness, and Accident Insurance, plus ID Theft Protection and Pet Insurance.
Time to Recharge: Enjoy accrued paid time off, paid holidays, and Employee Assistance Plan (EAP) access, which includes counseling, financial, and legal services, along with a vast library of online resources.
Invest in Yourself: Benefit from our Tuition Reimbursement Program for ongoing education and growth, plus CME/CEU and license reimbursements for eligible roles.

This is more than just a benefits package—it’s a commitment to your health, well-being, and professional success!

Learn more about Elica’s services and mission at our website or check us out on Facebook.

Requirements

The successful candidate will be willing and able to:

Patient Coordination: Manage and coordinate patient care activities, ensuring effective communication between patients, healthcare providers, and external agencies. Maintain patient caseloads of 60-200; daily caseload of 12-16 cases/patients per day.
Patient Education: Provide patients and their families with education regarding their health conditions, treatment plans, and available resources.
Scheduling and Follow-Up: Assist patients in scheduling appointments, follow-up visits, and referrals to specialists, ensuring continuity of care.
Bilingual Communication: Utilize bilingual skills (Russian Preferred) to effectively communicate with a diverse patient population, ensuring that language barriers do not hinder the delivery of care.
Documentation: Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records, including care plans, progress notes, and communication logs at EPIC.
Resource Coordination: Connect patients with community resources, social services, and support programs to address social determinants of health.
Care Plan Development: Collaborate with healthcare providers to develop and implement individualized care plans tailored to each patient's needs.

new_jobs.title: Quality Control Technician
new_jobs.description:
Job Title: Quality Control Technician

Shift:
Monday-Friday 2PM-10:30PM PT

Job Description

The Quality Control Technician performs a wide range of chemical, physical, and instrumental tests on raw materials, in-process products, finished goods, and customer samples to ensure consistent product quality and adherence to specifications. This role follows established analytical procedures, validates methods, manages laboratory data in electronic systems, and collaborates closely with Quality, Production, and R&D teams to support reliable manufacturing processes and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Perform chemical, physical, and instrumental testing on raw materials, in-process, finished, and customer product samples, including volumetric and gravimetric analyses, pH measurement, FTIR, SPG, RI, and other instrumental techniques.
Conduct functional testing such as IACS and thermal conductivity as needed to verify product performance.
Follow written analytical procedures and standard operating procedures to ensure consistency and compliance in all testing activities.
Validate established analytical methods and assist in troubleshooting testing procedures to maintain accurate and reliable results.
Collect, enter, review, and validate laboratory data in WinLIMS or similar data management systems, perform necessary calculations, and prepare results for review and approval.
Communicate sample status, test progress, and final results clearly and promptly to Quality, Production, and R&D teams.
Maintain accurate and complete laboratory documentation, including SOPs, test methods, protocols, deviations, batch records, and certificates of analysis (COAs).
Handle hazardous materials safely, ensuring proper storage, labeling, and disposal in accordance with site safety and chemical hygiene protocols.
Follow all site safety guidelines and chemical hygiene practices to maintain a safe working environment.
Troubleshoot basic process and testing issues, identify potential root causes, and escalate complex problems appropriately.
Log process and test data accurately using computer systems and software tools.
Work collaboratively in a team environment, supporting colleagues and contributing to a culture of quality and continuous improvement.
Manage time effectively to prioritize multiple testing assignments and meet production and customer deadlines.
Maintain strong attention to detail and focus on process control, documentation accuracy, and overall product quality.

Essential Skills

Experience in quality control and analytical testing within a laboratory or production environment.
Ability to perform chemical and physical analyses, including volumetric and gravimetric methods and pH measurement.
Hands-on experience with instrumental techniques such as FTIR, SPG, RI, and related analytical equipment.
Capability to conduct functional testing, including IACS and thermal conductivity measurements.
Proficiency in following written analytical procedures and standard operating procedures accurately.
Experience collecting, entering, reviewing, and validating data in WinLIMS or similar laboratory information management systems.
Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and the ability to log and manage process data.
Strong attention to detail with a focus on process control, thorough documentation, and maintaining high quality standards.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment, follow instructions, and communicate clearly with cross-functional groups.
Good time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
Comfort working with hazardous materials while adhering to safety and chemical hygiene protocols.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

B.S. in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related scientific or engineering field.
materials testing, including experience working with metals or similar materials.
Quality control experience in an industrial, manufacturing, or laboratory setting.
Laboratory experience gained in academia or industry, including hands-on work with analytical instruments and test methods.
Familiarity with statistical analysis software such as Minitab is a plus.
Strong documentation skills for maintaining SOPs, test methods, protocols, deviations, batch records, and COAs.
Effective interpersonal and communication skills for collaborating with Quality, Production, and R&D teams.
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot basic process and testing issues and escalate more complex problems appropriately.

Work Environment

The role is based in a laboratory environment that supports production and quality control operations. The Quality Control Technician works with a variety of analytical instruments and functional testing equipment, including FTIR and tools for SPG, RI, IACS, and thermal conductivity measurements. Daily work involves handling chemicals and hazardous materials in accordance with established safety and chemical hygiene protocols, with an emphasis on proper storage, labeling, and disposal. The position relies on computer-based tools such as WinLIMS or similar laboratory information management systems, as well as Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, for data entry, analysis, and reporting. The technician collaborates regularly with Quality, Production, and R&D teams, contributing to a supportive, team-oriented culture focused on accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Summary

Laboratory Assistant utilizes universal precautions and appropriate laboratory safety practices and knowledge of laboratory science to perform a variety of technical and clerical duties and tasks. The Assistant performs duties such as venipuncture, EKG’s, specimen processing and urine drug screen collections.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The following list of job duties fall within the scope of the laboratory assistant. Staff only perform the job duties for which they have completed initial and annual competency assessments. All lab assistants do not perform all functions listed.

Verifies the accuracy of patient registration information in computer.
Prioritizes and enters orders.
Obtains specimens for testing for all age groups including finger stick glucose.
Receives and processes all requests for laboratory orders, results and reports. Enters and retrieves data from computer system.
Answers telephones and routes calls as appropriate.
Processes and packages specimens as required for delivery to main laboratory and/or reference laboratories.
Review pending logs and reports every shift.
Performs physician prescribed EKG testing.
Performs legal drug collection.
Inventories and maintains department supplies. Notifies Supervisor of supply needs when stock is low.
Cleans glassware from all areas of the laboratory.
May perform Evidential Breath Testing (EBT).
May perform registrations using procedure specified in training.
May set up microbiology cultures.
May need to transport specimens to other locations.
May perform document scanning into the electronic medical record.
Demonstrates System Values in performance and behavior.
Complies with System policies and procedures.
Other duties as may be assigned.

Education And Experience

High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one to three months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Licenses, Certifications

Minimum CPT1 (California: Phlebotomy Technician) or higher. Tahoe Forest Hospital Laboratory Assistants are also needed to cover events at the Incline Village Community Hospital. In these cases, the staff that are scheduled at that location are licensed by the State of Nevada and meet all requirements of the IVCH Lab Assistant Job Description.

new_jobs.title: Care Coordinator - Russian/Farsi/Dari Bilingual Speakers Preferred
new_jobs.description:
Description

Join Elica’s mission and become a part of a team where every day is an opportunity to make a positive impact in your community!

At Elica Health Centers, we share a common goal: provide the best possible patient care to our growing community! Our passion extends throughout Elica, from the exceptional healthcare services we provide to our underserved patients at our Community Health Clinics and state-of-the-art mobile medicine program, Health on Wheels, to our Resource Center where we empower patients and members of the community to connect with resources to help them build healthy and full lives.

We are growing our Enhanced Care Management (ECM) program at Elica! ECM is a key part of CalAIM’s new statewide Medi-Cal benefit available to select “Populations of Focus" with complex needs and who are facing difficult life and health circumstances. This program is focused on breaking down the traditional walls of health care – extending beyond hospitals and health care settings into communities. ECM will address clinical and non-clinical needs of the highest-need enrollees through intensive coordination of health and health-related services and will meet beneficiaries wherever they are – on the street, in a shelter, in their doctor's office, or at home.

What You'll Do

Care Coordinators assist patients to receive timely and effective care from Elica’s internal providers as well as referrals to community resources outside of Elica. The ultimate goal is well-coordinated care and optimal clinical outcomes. Care Coordinators work with patients individually and within a team environment to achieve these goals and because of their

education & skills, are best able to educate patients as to the health benefits of coordinated care.

Benefits

Retirement Savings Made Easy: Enjoy a 403(b) retirement plan with up to 4% employer matching and 100% immediate vesting—start building your future from day one!
Comprehensive Healthcare Options: Choose from two Anthem Blue Cross PPO plans for medical, plus dental and vision coverage for you and your family.
Employer-Funded HRA: Our Health Reimbursement Arrangement helps cover out-of-pocket medical costs, giving you peace of mind.
Flexible Spending Accounts: Take advantage of two FSA options: Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA, tailored to suit your needs.
Security for the Unexpected: We provide company-paid basic Life and AD&D Insurance, with options to enhance coverage.
Enhanced Protection: Explore additional benefits like Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness, and Accident Insurance, plus ID Theft Protection and Pet Insurance.
Time to Recharge: Enjoy accrued paid time off, paid holidays, and Employee Assistance Plan (EAP) access, which includes counseling, financial, and legal services, along with a vast library of online resources.
Invest in Yourself: Benefit from our Tuition Reimbursement Program for ongoing education and growth, plus CME/CEU and license reimbursements for eligible roles.

This is more than just a benefits package—it’s a commitment to your health, well-being, and professional success!

Learn more about Elica’s services and mission at our website or check us out on Facebook.

Requirements

The successful candidate will be willing and able to:

Patient Coordination: Manage and coordinate patient care activities, ensuring effective communication between patients, healthcare providers, and external agencies. Maintain patient caseloads of 60-200; daily caseload of 12-16 cases/patients per day.
Patient Education: Provide patients and their families with education regarding their health conditions, treatment plans, and available resources.
Scheduling and Follow-Up: Assist patients in scheduling appointments, follow-up visits, and referrals to specialists, ensuring continuity of care.
Bilingual Communication: Utilize bilingual skills (Russian Preferred) to effectively communicate with a diverse patient population, ensuring that language barriers do not hinder the delivery of care.
Documentation: Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records, including care plans, progress notes, and communication logs at EPIC.
Resource Coordination: Connect patients with community resources, social services, and support programs to address social determinants of health.
Care Plan Development: Collaborate with healthcare providers to develop and implement individualized care plans tailored to each patient's needs.
Team Collaboration: Work closely with other members of the healthcare team to ensure a multidisciplinary approach to patient care.
Quality Improvement: Participate in quality improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing patient care and service delivery.
Compliance and Confidentiality: Adhere to all organizational policies, procedures, and regulations, including patient confidentiality and HIPAA compliance.
Other tasks related to the work of the social care department.

Work Location & Schedule

This position is 100% onsite and does not offer remote or hybrid work options during the first

year of employment.

Work Location: 5735 Watt Avenue, North Highlands, CA 95660
Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m. Participation in community

events on weekends as necessary.

Regular, in-person attendance at the office is an essential function of this role due to the nature

of patient coordination, team collaboration, and community-based work.

The Successful Candidate Must Have

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Social Work, or a related field preferred.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in healthcare, preferably in care coordination or patient navigation in the Sacramento, Yolo, or Placer counties.
EHR Experience: Experience working with EPIC electronic health record (EHR) system is preferred.
Experience working with diverse patient populations, including non-English speaking individuals.
Multilingual Russian and Farsi/Dari are highly preferred.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Proficiency in using EPIC EHR for patient documentation, scheduling, and coordination of care.
Basic computer skills, including familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Google Spaces).

Essential Skills/Abilities

Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport with patients, families, and healthcare team members.
Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities efficiently.
Attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining patient records and documentation.
Understanding of healthcare systems, community resources, and social determinants of health.
Knowledge of patient advocacy and care planning principles.
Ability to assess patient needs, identify potential barriers to care, and develop effective solutions.
Familiarity with healthcare regulations, including HIPAA, and commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality.
Ability to adapt to changes in a fast-paced healthcare environment and support continuous quality improvement initiative

Additional Requirements

Must have a current and valid California driver’s license and the ability to provide proof of personal auto insurance on the vehicle driven during working hours.

Physical Requirements And Work Environment

The work environment is office, clinic and field based administering program education and Care Coordination to Adults, Children and Youth and recent immigrants. Work environment includes office, clinic, field work. Employees are to adhere to field visit policies, including, but not limited to being accompanied by a colleague while working with clients in a not public setting. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee is also required to stand; walk; and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee must also possess hearing and speech to communicate in person and over the phone. The noise level in the work environment can range from quiet to moderately loud; the incumbent must be able to focus in an environment with many distractions.

The employee may be in contact with individuals and families in crisis who may be ill, using substances and/or not attentive to personal health. The employee may experience a number of unpleasant sensory demands associated with the client’s use of alcohol and drugs, and the lack of personal care. The employee may also be exposed to bio-hazardous materials (bodily fluids including blood and urine) and hazardous chemicals. The employee must be ready to respond quickly and effectively to many types of situations, including crisis situations and potentially hostile situations.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Elica Health Centers is a healthcare facility that adheres to the mandates issued by the California Department of Public Health including the recent orders regarding the COVID-19 vaccine. Medical and religious exemptions will be considered.

Compensation - Dependent Upon Experience

$25.00 - $30.00 an hour
